function assetURL(p){let data=FILES[p];if(!data)return null;let bytes=fileBytes(p);let ext=p.split('.').pop().toLowerCase();let types={svg:'image/svg+xml',jpg:'image/jpeg',jpeg:'image/jpeg',png:'image/png',gif:'image/gif',webp:'image/webp',woff:'font/woff',woff2:'font/woff2',pdf:'application/pdf',epub:'application/epub+zip',mp3:'audio/mpeg',json:'application/json'};return URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([bytes],{type:types[ext]||'application/octet-stream'}))}

function updateTrail(){document.querySelectorAll('#subnav button').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.path===activePath));$('back').disabled=cursor<=0;$('forward').disabled=cursor<0||cursor>=historyStack.length-1}
function go(path,{push=true}={}){if(!READY)return;let p=splitPath(path);if(!FILES[p]&&p==='v15/before-the-ending-reader/full-book.pdf'){go('v15/before-the-ending-reader/full-reader.html',{push});$('status').textContent='The illustrated PDF is not embedded; opened the full text reader instead.';return}if(!FILES[p]){showError('Original page not found: '+path);return}if(push){historyStack=historyStack.slice(0,cursor+1);historyStack.push(path);cursor=historyStack.length-1}activePath=path;updateTrail();const pdf=/\.(pdf|epub)$/i.test(p);if(pdf){showBinary(p);return}renderPage(p,path)}

function urlForCSS(raw,from){return raw.replace(/url\(\s*(["']?)([^)"']+)\1\s*\)/gi,(m,q,path)=>{let v=normalizePath(path,from);if(!v)return m;let asset=assetURL(splitPath(v));return asset?'url("'+asset+'")':m})}
function prepare(raw,p,full){let base=p.slice(0,p.lastIndexOf('/')+1);let code=raw;let virtualQuery=(full.includes('?')?'?'+full.split('?')[1].split('#')[0]:'');
// Original scripts remain intact and execute in their original order. External local scripts are inlined, not omitted.
code=code.replace(/<script\b([^>]*?)\bsrc\s*=\s*["']([^"']+)["']([^>]*)>\s*<\/script>/gi,(full,pre,src,post)=>{const target=normalizePath(src,p);if(!target||!FILES[splitPath(target)])return full;let content=fileText(splitPath(target));if(!content)return full;return '<script '+pre.replace(/\bsrc\s*=\s*["'][^"']+["']/gi,'')+' '+post+'>'+content.replace(/<\/script/gi,'<\\/script')+'<\/script>'});

if(virtualQuery)code=code.replace(/\blocation\.search\b/g,JSON.stringify(virtualQuery));
// External media in static HTML is packaged as an object URL; original image content is not removed.
code=code.replace(/(<(?:img|audio|video|source|track)\b[^>]*?\b(?:src|poster)\s*=\s*["'])([^"']+)(["'])/gi,(full,a,src,z)=>{let target=normalizePath(src,p);let url=target&&assetURL(splitPath(target));return url?a+url+z:full});
// Convert relative background images/font URLs found in inline course stylesheets.
code=code.replace(/<style\b([^>]*)>([\s\S]*?)<\/style>/gi,(m,attrs,css)=>'<style'+attrs+'>'+urlForCSS(css,p)+'</style>');

/* These source pages were originally hosted with same-origin storage and history.

try{window.localStorage.getItem('__study_storage_probe__')}catch(e){

 const fallback={getItem(k){k=String(k);return localMap.has(k)?localMap.get(k):null},setItem(k,v){k=String(k);v=String(v);localMap.set(k,v);window.parent.postMessage({type:'study-course-storage',page:CURRENT,key:k,value:v,op:'set'},'*')},removeItem(k){k=String(k);localMap.delete(k);window.parent.postMessage({type:'study-course-storage',page:CURRENT,key:k,op:'remove'},'*')},clear(){localMap.clear();window.parent.postMessage({type:'study-course-storage',page:CURRENT,op:'clear'},'*')},key(i){return Array.from(localMap.keys())[Number(i)]||null},get length(){return localMap.size}};

}

function localURL(href){if(!href||href.startsWith('#')||href.startsWith('//')||/^(https?:|mailto:|tel:|javascript:|data:|blob:)/i.test(href))return null;try{let u=new URL(href,'https://study.local/'+CURRENT);if(u.origin!=='https://study.local')return null;return u.pathname.slice(1)+u.search+u.hash}catch{return null}}window.addEventListener('click',function(e){let a=e.target.closest&&e.target.closest('a[href]');if(!a||a.classList.contains('skip-to-lesson'))return;let target=localURL(a.getAttribute('href'));if(!target)return;e.preventDefault();window.parent.postMessage({type:'study-virtual-go',target:target},'*')},true);window.addEventListener('mouseup',function(){let text=String(window.getSelection&&window.getSelection()||'').trim().slice(0,250);if(text.length>2)window.parent.postMessage({type:'study-selection',text:text},'*')},true);window.addEventListener('error',function(e){window.parent.postMessage({type:'study-child-error',page:CURRENT,message:String(e.message||'Unknown script error')},'*')});window.addEventListener('unhandledrejection',function(e){window.parent.postMessage({type:'study-child-error',page:CURRENT,message:String(e.reason||'Unknown promise rejection')},'*')});const oldFetch=window.fetch&&window.fetch.bind(window);window.fetch=function(input,options){let target=localURL(typeof input==='string'?input:input?.url||'');if(target){return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){let id=Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);let event=function(ev){if(ev.data?.type!=='study-virtual-resource'||ev.data?.id!==id)return;window.removeEventListener('message',event);if(!ev.data.ok){resolve(new Response('Not found',{status:404}));return;}resolve(new Response(ev.data.content,{status:200,headers:{'Content-Type':ev.data.mime||'text/plain'}}))};window.addEventListener('message',event);window.parent.postMessage({type:'study-resource-request',id:id,target:target},'*')})}return oldFetch?oldFetch(input,options):Promise.reject(new Error('Network unavailable'))};})();<\/script>`;
const pos=code.search(/<head\b[^>]*>/i);if(pos>=0){const at=code.indexOf('>',pos)+1;code=code.slice(0,at)+shim+code.slice(at)}else code=shim+code;

function renderPage(p,full){$('pageTitle').textContent=p.split('/').pop().replace(/[-_]/g,' ');$('screen').innerHTML='<iframe class="frame" id="frame" title="Complete original course: '+escapeHTML(p)+'" allow="microphone; autoplay"></iframe>';$('frame').srcdoc=prepare(fileText(p),p,full);$('status').textContent='Your course · '+p+' · Local lessons work offline';const params=full.slice(p.length),routedFrame=$('frame');if(params.startsWith('#')){const applyHash=()=>{try{if(routedFrame!==$('frame')){routedFrame.removeEventListener('load',applyHash);return}const child=routedFrame.contentWindow;if(!child||child.document.URL.startsWith('about:blank')||child.document.readyState!=='complete')return;routedFrame.removeEventListener('load',applyHash);child.location.hash=params}catch{routedFrame.removeEventListener('load',applyHash)}};routedFrame.addEventListener('load',applyHash);applyHash()}}
window.addEventListener('message',event=>{if(event.source!==$('frame')?.contentWindow)return;let d=event.data;if(!d||typeof d!=='object')return;if(d.type==='study-virtual-go'){let target=decodeURIComponent(d.target||'');if(FILES[splitPath(target)])go(target);else $('status').textContent='This page links to a resource not included in the original archive: '+target}else if(d.type==='study-child-error'){$('status').textContent='Page script warning: '+String(d.message).slice(0,130)}else if(d.type==='study-resource-request'){let p=splitPath(d.target),e=FILES[p];event.source.postMessage({type:'study-virtual-resource',id:d.id,ok:!!e,content:e?(e.t??''):'',mime:p.endsWith('.json')?'application/json':'text/plain'},'*')}});
$('home').onclick=showHome;$('back').onclick=()=>{if(cursor>0){cursor--;go(historyStack[cursor],{push:false})}};$('forward').onclick=()=>{if(cursor+1<historyStack.length){cursor++;go(historyStack[cursor],{push:false})}};$('search').oninput=e=>renderResults(e.target.value);

const COACH_BANK={"spanish":[{"key":"ser vs estar","aliases":["ser","estar","soy","estoy","eres","estas","estás"],"plain":"Spanish uses two verbs for “to be.” Ser is usually for identity or defining characteristics; estar is usually for location, temporary states, and results. They are not always simply permanent versus temporary.","steps":["Ask: am I saying what something is, or how/where it is?","Use ser for identity: Soy estudiante — I am a student.","Use estar for a state or location: Estoy cansado — I am tired."],"example":"Soy de Nueva York, pero estoy en México. The written vowel sounds are fairly consistent, and rhythm matters more than speaking quickly.","steps":["A sounds like ah, E like eh, I like ee, O like oh, U like oo.","Break a phrase into small chunks, then join them.","Use the audio and speaking features in the complete Spanish studio when supported."],"example":"Me encantaría: meh / en-kahn-tah-REE-ah. Checkmate means the king is in check and no legal move can remove that attack.","steps":["When you hear “check,” look at which piece attacks your king.","Look for three kinds of defense: move the king, capture the attacker, or block the attack.","If none is legal, it is checkmate."],"example":"If your king is attacked by a rook, stepping out of the attacked file may save it—if the destination is safe.","question":"What must you do when your king is in check?","choices":["Ignore it and attack elsewhere.","Make a legal move that removes the check.","Move the queen."],"right":1,"feedback":"You cannot leave your own king in check.","foundation":"Ask one question each move: “Is my king safe after this?”"},{"key":"opening principles","aliases":["opening","develop","development","center","castle","castling"],"plain":"In the opening, the basic goals are to fight for the center, develop pieces, and make the king safe. Memorized moves matter less than understanding these goals.","steps":["Move one or two central pawns to free your pieces.","Bring knights and bishops toward useful squares.","Castle when legal and sensible to protect your king."],"example":"1.e4 opens lines for the bishop and queen while controlling central squares.","question":"Which opening plan is usually healthier?","choices":["Move one knight five times.","Develop several pieces and keep the king safe.","Push random edge pawns."],"right":1,"feedback":"Development helps more pieces participate in the game.","foundation":"Before every opening move, ask: “Does this improve a piece, help the center, or protect my king?”"},{"key":"hanging pieces","aliases":["hanging","undefended","en prise","threat","blunder"],"plain":"A piece is “hanging” when an opponent can capture it profitably and it is not adequately defended. Before each move, scan what becomes vulnerable.","steps":["Look at what your opponent attacked on the last move.","Count attackers and defenders, noting the value of each piece.","Ask whether your intended move leaves something for free."],"example":"If your knight is attacked by a pawn and cannot be recaptured favorably, you should usually move or defend it.","question":"Before making your move, what check catches many blunders?","choices":["What is the weather?","What can my opponent capture next?","Can I move the same pawn twice?"],"right":1,"feedback":"Scanning immediate captures prevents many beginner mistakes.","foundation":"Pause and inspect every enemy queen, rook, bishop, knight, and pawn attack."},{"key":"forks and pins","aliases":["fork","pin","tactic","skewer","double attack"],"plain":"A fork attacks two things at once, often with a knight. A pin prevents or discourages a piece from moving because something valuable stands behind it.","steps":["Identify the opponent’s valuable targets.","Look for a move that attacks two targets simultaneously.","For pins, inspect straight lines with an enemy piece and the king or queen behind it."],"example":"A knight may fork a king and queen; the king must respond, so the queen may be lost.","question":"A knight attacks a king and queen on the same move. This is a…","choices":["Fork","Castle","Stalemate"],"right":0,"feedback":"A fork is one move threatening multiple pieces.","foundation":"Learn the difference: fork = two simultaneous targets; pin = one piece held in place by what is behind it."},{"key":"chess notation","aliases":["notation","e4","Nf3","san","fen","coordinates","files","ranks"],"plain":"Chess notation is an address system. Files are letters a–h across the board, ranks are numbers 1–8 up the board from White’s side.","steps":["Find file e (the fifth column).","Find rank 4 (the fourth row from White).","e4 is the square where that column and row meet."],"example":"Nf3 means a knight moves to f3. The N stands for knight because K stands for king.","question":"What does the letter N mean in Nf3?","choices":["King","Knight","Pawn"],"right":1,"feedback":"N distinguishes knight from king (K).","foundation":"First learn square addresses, then short moves such as e4 and Nf3."},{"key":"endgame basics","aliases":["endgame","opposition","promotion","king and pawn"],"plain":"In many endgames the king becomes an active fighting piece. A pawn reaching the farthest rank can promote, usually to a queen.","steps":["Activate your king safely.","Support and advance passed pawns.","Watch the opponent’s promotion threats and basic checkmates."],"example":"A white pawn reaching the eighth rank may promote to a queen, rook, bishop, or knight.","question":"What usually happens when a pawn reaches the last rank?","choices":["It becomes a chosen promotion piece.","It must stop.","It becomes a king."],"right":0,"feedback":"Promotion is one reason a single pawn can determine an endgame.","foundation":"Picture the pawn as a runner that gets upgraded at the finish line."}],"piano":[{"key":"finding notes","aliases":["middle c","keyboard","note names","c major","keys","octave"],"plain":"The white piano keys repeat seven letter names: A B C D E F G. Middle C is the C near the center of a standard 88-key piano.","steps":["Find a group of two black keys.","The white key just to their left is C.","Move right: D, E, F, G, A, B, then C again."],"example":"Play C–D–E–D–C slowly. You are already playing a little melody.","question":"Which white key is immediately left of two black keys?","choices":["C","F","A"],"right":0,"feedback":"That visual landmark works across the keyboard.","foundation":"Forget sheet music for a moment: find groups of two and three black keys first."},{"key":"rhythm and pulse","aliases":["rhythm","beat","tempo","quarter note","rests","timing"],"plain":"The beat is a steady pulse, like walking. Rhythm is the pattern of shorter and longer sounds you place on that pulse.","steps":["Clap a steady count: 1, 2, 3, 4.","Keep counting while you say or tap a simple rhythm.","Play only after your hands can clap the timing."],"example":"Say “TA TA TA-A-A” over four beats: two short notes and one two-beat note.","question":"What should stay steady when you practice rhythm?","choices":["The underlying beat","Every note length","The loudness"],"right":0,"feedback":"Notes may be longer or shorter, but the underlying pulse remains steady.","foundation":"Imagine footsteps as beats; your claps can fall on or between those steps."},{"key":"major chords","aliases":["chord","triad","c major","major third","harmony"],"plain":"A basic major chord stacks the root, the major third, and the fifth. The C major chord is C–E–G.","steps":["Put your thumb on C.","Leave a white key between each selected note: C, E, G.","Play all three together, then one at a time."],"example":"C–E–G sounds stable because these notes form a simple major triad.","question":"Which notes make a C major chord?","choices":["C–D–E","C–E–G","C–F–A"],"right":1,"feedback":"C–E–G is root, third, and fifth.","foundation":"A chord is several notes together; a triad is a three-note chord."},{"key":"reading sheet music","aliases":["staff","treble clef","bass clef","sheet music","notation","lines","spaces"],"plain":"Sheet music is a map: vertical position shows pitch, and symbol shapes show how long a note lasts. For treble clef, the lines from bottom to top are E G B D F.","steps":["Locate the five staff lines.","In treble clef, name the bottom line E.","Work upward: E G B D F on lines, F A C E in spaces."],"example":"A note on the bottom treble line is E. The C major scale uses only white notes from C to the next C.","steps":["Play the first five notes slowly: C D E F G.","Try one hand at a time and keep fingers relaxed.","Add the remaining notes when the motion feels easy."],"example":"C D E F G A B C. Slow clean notes beat fast uneven notes.","question":"What is the main goal of slow scale practice?","choices":["Move as fast as possible.","Build reliable, relaxed movements.","Use only black keys."],"right":1,"feedback":"Comfort and accuracy matter before speed.","foundation":"A scale is simply an ordered path across nearby notes."},{"key":"playing with both hands","aliases":["both hands","left hand","right hand","coordination","independence"],"plain":"Two-hand piano is usually easier when you learn each hand alone first, then combine tiny pieces.","steps":["Play the right hand phrase very slowly.","Practice the left hand independently.","Join just the first one or two notes from each hand."],"example":"Play a C chord in the left hand while the right plays C–D–E. First pause after each note.","question":"Which approach is usually less frustrating?","choices":["Attempt the whole song at full speed.","Combine two notes at a time after practicing separately.","Ignore the left hand forever."],"right":1,"feedback":"Build coordination in small chunks.","foundation":"The hands can move at different times; that is a learned skill, not a talent test."}],"life":[{"key":"thinking in probabilities","aliases":["probability","uncertainty","risk","expected value","odds"],"plain":"Good decisions do not require perfect predictions. Estimate several possible outcomes, how likely they are, and what each would cost or give you.","steps":["Name the possible outcomes.","Estimate rough likelihoods—even wide ranges can help.","Compare likely benefit with downside and decide what information would change the choice."],"example":"A 20% chance of saving $1,000 has an expected dollar value of $200 before effort and other costs.","question":"What is most useful when the future is uncertain?","choices":["Pretend you know exactly what will happen.","Consider outcomes, likelihoods, and consequences.","Avoid any decision."],"right":1,"feedback":"Probability-based thinking acknowledges uncertainty rather than hiding it.","foundation":"Begin with two outcomes: what if it works, and what if it does not?"},{"key":"sunk costs","aliases":["sunk cost","past effort","already spent","sunk cost fallacy"],"plain":"Money or time already spent cannot be recovered by continuing. A good next decision compares future benefits and future costs.","steps":["Name the past cost, then set it aside for the next decision.","Ask what staying would cost from today forward.","Choose based on what is best now, not to justify the past."],"example":"Finishing a boring course solely because you already studied ten hours may waste ten more.","question":"You dislike a course you prepaid for. Which matters most now?","choices":["That you paid earlier.","Whether continuing is worth your time today.","What others might think."],"right":1,"feedback":"The sunk cost cannot be changed; the next hour can.","foundation":"Imagine you had not started yet. Would you choose this again?"},{"key":"incentives","aliases":["incentive","motivations","principal agent","conflicts"],"plain":"People respond not just to stated goals but also to what rewards, punishes, or inconveniences them. Understanding incentives explains surprising behavior.","steps":["Ask what the person wants.","Ask what they are measured or paid for.","Consider how those incentives differ from the stated objective."],"example":"A salesperson paid only for signups might favor volume over long-term customer fit.","question":"To understand an organization’s behavior, look at…","choices":["Only its slogans.","Its incentives and constraints.","Only its logo."],"right":1,"feedback":"Incentives often explain repeated patterns better than stated intentions.","foundation":"Ask: what happens to this person if they do a good job? What happens if they do not?"},{"key":"critical thinking","aliases":["evidence","critical thinking","bias","belief","epistemology","source"],"plain":"A strong belief should have reasons behind it—and a clear idea of what evidence could change it. Confidence and evidence are different things.","steps":["Define the exact claim.","Separate what you saw from what someone inferred.","Look for independent evidence or an alternative explanation."],"example":"“Sales went up after the redesign” does not by itself prove that the redesign caused the rise.","question":"Which is the stronger habit?","choices":["Ask what evidence would disprove a claim.","Trust the loudest speaker.","Assume correlation proves causation."],"right":0,"feedback":"A good test is what you would expect to see if the claim were false.","foundation":"Start with: What do I know firsthand? What was I told?"},{"key":"habits and attention","aliases":["habit","focus","attention","routine","discipline"],"plain":"Habits are easier when the next action is small and the environment makes it obvious. Your attention is finite; make the starting step easy.","steps":["Choose one tiny action, e.g. two minutes of Spanish.","Attach it to an existing moment, e.g. after coffee.","Stop or continue freely; aim for repeatability rather than punishment."],"example":"Opening a piano lesson for three minutes counts as starting, even if you do not finish it.","question":"What makes a new habit easier to begin?","choices":["A huge daily target.","A tiny clear first action.","Guilt when you miss a day."],"right":1,"feedback":"Reducing friction helps a behavior become repeatable.","foundation":"You can always do more after the first small step."},{"key":"decision journaling","aliases":["decision journal","journal","decision","reflection"],"plain":"A decision journal records your reasoning before you know the outcome, so hindsight cannot quietly rewrite what you believed.","steps":["Write the choice and alternatives.","Record your estimate of risks, hopes, and evidence.","Set a later date to compare your thinking with what happened."],"example":"“I estimate 60% this partnership works because X; I would revise if Y happens.”","question":"Why record your reasoning before the outcome?","choices":["To impress other people.","To learn without rewriting the past.","To guarantee success."],"right":1,"feedback":"A journal separates decision quality from luck.","foundation":"Just record what you thought, why, and what would make you change your mind."}],"medicine":[{"key":"homeostasis","aliases":["homeostasis","blood pressure","temperature","balance"],"plain":"Homeostasis means the body constantly adjusts to keep essential internal conditions within workable ranges, despite changes outside it.","steps":["Identify the variable being regulated—temperature, blood sugar, blood pressure.","Find sensors and feedback responses.","See how organs cooperate to correct deviations."],"example":"When you become hot, sweating helps remove heat while blood flow to the skin increases.","question":"Sweating in heat is an example of…","choices":["Homeostasis","A chromosome","A vaccine"],"right":0,"feedback":"Sweating is part of temperature regulation.","foundation":"Think of a thermostat: sense a change, then respond to reduce it."},{"key":"heart and lungs","aliases":["heart","lung","oxygen","circulation","blood","respiratory"],"plain":"The lungs exchange oxygen and carbon dioxide with the air. The heart pumps blood so cells can receive oxygen and remove waste.","steps":["Air reaches tiny sacs called alveoli.","Oxygen moves into blood as carbon dioxide moves out.","The heart circulates oxygen-rich blood to body tissues."],"example":"During exercise, breathing and heart rate usually rise to support increased demand.","question":"Which statement is accurate?","choices":["Lungs pump blood to the feet.","Lungs exchange gases; the heart pumps blood.","The heart makes oxygen."],"right":1,"feedback":"The organs do different but connected jobs.","foundation":"Imagine delivery: lungs load oxygen onto trucks; the heart keeps the trucks moving."},{"key":"kidneys","aliases":["kidney","renal","creatinine","filtration","egfr"],"plain":"Kidneys filter blood, regulate fluid and electrolytes, and help control blood pressure. A single lab value needs clinical context.","steps":["Blood flows through tiny filtering units called nephrons.","Useful substances and water can be reclaimed.","Waste and excess fluid leave as urine."],"example":"A dehydration-related rise in creatinine may mean something different from a persistent pattern; a clinician assesses context.","question":"Which is one major kidney function?","choices":["Producing digestive enzymes.","Regulating water and filtering waste.","Pumping oxygen into the lungs."],"right":1,"feedback":"Kidneys coordinate filtering with fluid and electrolyte balance.","foundation":"Picture them as selective filters, not drains that remove everything."},{"key":"inflammation","aliases":["inflammation","immune","infection","fever","white blood cells"],"plain":"Inflammation is a coordinated defense-and-repair response. It is useful when proportionate, but can damage tissue if excessive or persistent.","steps":["A tissue detects damage or a threat.","Signals recruit immune cells and alter blood flow.","Repair begins while the response is eventually dialed down."],"example":"A small cut may become red, warm, and swollen as nearby vessels and immune cells respond.","question":"Which is true about inflammation?","choices":["It is always harmful.","It can protect and repair, but can also cause harm.","It happens only with viruses."],"right":1,"feedback":"Inflammation is not automatically a disease; context and duration matter.","foundation":"Start with the four classic clues: redness, warmth, swelling, pain."},{"key":"clinical reasoning","aliases":["differential","diagnosis","diagnostic","symptom","clinical case"],"plain":"Clinical reasoning means generating plausible explanations for symptoms, then narrowing them using context, examination, tests, and risk—not guessing from one clue.","steps":["Summarize the main symptom and timeline.","List multiple possible causes, including urgent dangerous ones.","Look for findings that make each cause more or less likely."],"example":"Dizziness after a run could involve heat, dehydration, low blood pressure, arrhythmia, or other causes; context matters.","question":"What is a differential diagnosis?","choices":["A list of plausible causes to evaluate.","The first guess.","A treatment plan only."],"right":0,"feedback":"A differential keeps alternatives in view while evidence is gathered.","foundation":"One symptom can have many causes; collect clues before concluding."},{"key":"medical evidence","aliases":["randomized trial","placebo","clinical study","evidence","risk ratio","absolute risk"],"plain":"Medical evidence is stronger when studies compare groups fairly, track meaningful outcomes, and distinguish absolute from relative effects.","steps":["Ask who was studied and for how long.","Check what outcome was actually measured.","Translate percentages into natural frequencies where possible."],"example":"A risk falling from 2 in 100 to 1 in 100 is a 50% relative reduction but a 1-percentage-point absolute reduction.","question":"Which gives useful perspective on a treatment benefit?","choices":["Only the relative percentage.","Both absolute and relative effects.","Only anecdotes."],"right":1,"feedback":"Absolute numbers make the size of an effect easier to judge.","foundation":"Always ask: out of 100 people like those studied, how many are affected?"}],"business":[{"key":"profit vs revenue","aliases":["revenue","profit","margin","expenses","gross margin"],"plain":"Revenue is the money coming in from sales. Profit is what remains after relevant costs. Growing sales does not always mean the business is healthier.","steps":["Count sales × price to get revenue.","Subtract costs that belong in the chosen profit measure.","Divide profit by revenue to find a profit margin."],"example":"10 sales at $20 = $200 revenue; $140 costs leaves $60 profit and a 30% profit margin.","question":"A shop earns $200 and spends $140. Profit is…","choices":["$340","$60","$200"],"right":1,"feedback":"Profit is revenue minus costs: 200 − 140 = 60.","foundation":"Money in is not money kept; always write both numbers down."},{"key":"unit economics","aliases":["unit economics","contribution margin","variable cost","break even","break-even"],"plain":"Unit economics asks whether a single customer or product sale contributes enough to cover costs. It matters even if a business has impressive growth.","steps":["Find price per sale.","Subtract variable costs like materials and fulfillment.","Compare contribution per sale with fixed costs and acquisition costs."],"example":"A $40 product with $16 variable cost contributes $24 before fixed costs.","question":"Price $40, variable cost $16. LTV estimates economic value across their relationship. Both depend on clear definitions.","steps":["Add relevant customer acquisition spend.","Divide by acquired customers for an approximate CAC.","Compare with contribution from retained customers over time."],"example":"$1,000 spent to acquire 20 customers implies $50 CAC, before finer attribution questions.","question":"Spend $1,000 to acquire 20 customers. CAC is…","choices":["$20","$50","$1,000"],"right":1,"feedback":"1,000 ÷ 20 = $50 per customer.","foundation":"One acquired customer should be worth more than it costs to acquire and serve them."},{"key":"cash flow","aliases":["cash flow","runway","working capital","invoice","accounts receivable"],"plain":"Profit is an accounting measure; cash flow tracks when money actually enters or leaves the bank. A profitable company can still run out of cash.","steps":["List money available today.","Forecast when customers actually pay.","Map bills and obligations against those dates."],"example":"A $20,000 sale invoiced today may not help pay rent due tomorrow if the customer pays in 60 days.","question":"Which statement is true?","choices":["Profit guarantees cash in the bank.","A profitable company can face a cash shortage.","Invoices are always paid immediately."],"right":1,"feedback":"Payment timing can create a cash crunch despite reported earnings.","foundation":"Separate “I earned it” from “I received it.”"},{"key":"sales objections","aliases":["objection","too expensive","pricing objection","sales conversation","discovery"],"plain":"A price objection can mean the budget is too small, but it can also mean the expected value is unclear, timing is wrong, or risk feels too high.","steps":["Acknowledge the concern without arguing.","Ask one genuine question to identify what makes the cost hard to justify.","Connect a relevant outcome to the prospect’s economics, if supported by evidence."],"example":"“What would need to be true for the return to justify this price?” invites a useful conversation.","question":"A buyer says “too expensive.” What is a sensible next step?","choices":["Immediately slash the price.","Understand what value or risk is unresolved.","Argue that the buyer is wrong."],"right":1,"feedback":"A diagnosis beats a canned rebuttal.","foundation":"Ask whether the obstacle is money, trust, timing, or lack of expected return."},{"key":"experiments and validation","aliases":["mvp","experiment","validation","hypothesis","a/b test","product market fit"],"plain":"Early experiments reduce uncertainty before you spend heavily. A good test has a clear hypothesis and an observable outcome.","steps":["State the hypothesis plainly.","Pick a test small enough to run quickly.","Define what result would change your plan before you start."],"example":"Instead of building a full product, invite 20 likely customers to a paid pilot and measure commitments.","question":"A strong early experiment should…","choices":["Only collect compliments.","Test behavior relevant to the business model.","Take a year to run."],"right":1,"feedback":"Customer actions usually teach more than general enthusiasm.","foundation":"Ask for the smallest honest test of actual demand."}],"books":[{"key":"finding the thesis","aliases":["thesis","main idea","argument","author claim","book summary"],"plain":"A good book summary begins with the author’s central claim, not a list of chapter titles. Then it explains the most important reasons and examples.","steps":["State the big idea in one sentence.","Identify two reasons the author gives.","Ask what a skeptical reader would challenge."],"example":"“Habits become easier when the environment reduces friction” is a thesis; one morning routine is only an example.","question":"What belongs in a strong summary first?","choices":["A complete list of proper nouns.","The central argument in plain language.","Only the ending."],"right":1,"feedback":"Start with what the book is trying to convince you of.","foundation":"Ask: “If I could remember one claim, what would it be?”"},{"key":"active recall","aliases":["active recall","remember","retention","flashcards","review"],"plain":"Retrieval is trying to remember without looking. It strengthens memory more than rereading alone, especially when revisited after delays.","steps":["Read a short section.","Close it and explain the idea in your own words.","Check what you missed, then try again later."],"example":"After reading three pages, say out loud what changed your understanding.","question":"Which is an example of active recall?","choices":["Rereading the same sentence repeatedly.","Explaining a concept from memory before checking.","Highlighting every paragraph."],"right":1,"feedback":"Retrieving a memory is a form of practice.","foundation":"A 20-second self-explanation counts, even if you forget part of it."},{"key":"evaluating sources","aliases":["historical sources","source criticism","primary source","bias","history"],"plain":"To evaluate a source, ask who created it, what they knew, who their audience was, and what they had reason to hide or emphasize.","steps":["Identify the source and when it was produced.","Ask what the author personally observed versus heard secondhand.","Compare independent evidence when stakes are high."],"example":"A general writing a victory report may understate mistakes; the report is still valuable but not neutral.","question":"What strengthens a historical claim?","choices":["Several independent sources agreeing on the key facts.","A single dramatic quote.","A modern retelling without references."],"right":0,"feedback":"Independence matters; copied claims are not separate confirmation.","foundation":"Every source has a position in the story. Find out what it is."},{"key":"applying ideas","aliases":["apply","transfer","learning","practice","use the idea"],"plain":"An idea becomes more useful when you try it in a real situation. Start with one concrete action, not a promise to change your entire life.","steps":["Choose one idea worth keeping.","Name a small situation where you could use it.","Test the idea and notice what actually happened."],"example":"After reading about incentives, examine what your own project rewards people for doing.","question":"What makes reading more likely to change behavior?","choices":["Collecting many quotes without using them.","Trying one idea in a real situation.","Forgetting the book immediately."],"right":1,"feedback":"Application connects the abstract idea to lived experience.","foundation":"Ask: “What could I do differently this week because of this?”"},{"key":"reading competing perspectives","aliases":["steelman","opposing view","critical reading","perspective","counterargument"],"plain":"Understanding a book does not mean agreeing with it. The best critique first represents the author’s strongest argument fairly.","steps":["Summarize the argument in a way the author would recognize.","Identify what evidence supports it.","Then test assumptions and plausible alternatives."],"example":"If an author says markets coordinate information well, examine both their strongest example and where coordination fails.","question":"Which critique is more useful?","choices":["Attack the weakest possible version.","Explain the best version, then test its evidence.","Reject without reading."],"right":1,"feedback":"Fair interpretation makes disagreement more informative.","foundation":"Try writing “Their strongest point is…” before writing “But…”"}]};

function h(text){return escapeHTML(String(text??''))}
function normal(text){return String(text||'').toLowerCase().normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').replace(/[’‘]/g,"'").replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim()}
function inferSubject(path){const p=splitPath(path);if(p==='learn.html'){let m=String(path).match(/[?&]subject=(life|medicine|business|books)/);if(m)return m[1]} for(const [s,obj] of Object.entries(SECTIONS)){if(obj.pages.some(x=>splitPath(x[1])===p))return s}if(/^v15\/spanish|^play\/spanish/.test(p))return 'spanish';if(/chess/i.test(p))return 'chess';if(/piano/i.test(p))return 'piano';if(/^life-curriculum/.test(p))return 'life';if(/body-school/.test(p))return 'medicine';if(/business-school/.test(p))return 'business';if(/^reading-room|before-the-ending/.test(p))return 'books';return subject}
function getNoteData(){return safeStore.get('notes',[])}
function trackVisit(path){showSelectionPreview('');const visits=safeStore.get('recent',[]).filter(x=>x!==path);visits.unshift(path);safeStore.set('recent',visits.slice(0,120));safeStore.set('last',path);setControls()}
function bookmarks(){return safeStore.get('bookmarks',[])}
function toggleBookmark(){if(!activePath)return;const list=bookmarks(),i=list.indexOf(activePath);if(i>=0)list.splice(i,1);else list.unshift(activePath);safeStore.set('bookmarks',list);setControls();$('live').textContent=i>=0?'Bookmark removed.':'Saved to your bookmarks on this device, or for this session if storage is blocked.'}
function setControls(){const active=!!activePath; if($('bookmark')){$('bookmark').disabled=!active;$('bookmark').textContent=active&&bookmarks().includes(activePath)?'★ Saved':'☆ Save place'}if($('helpBtn'))$('helpBtn').disabled=!active;if($('resumeBtn'))$('resumeBtn').disabled=!safeStore.get('last')}

const adventurePaths=['play/spanish.html','v15/chess-from-zero/index.html','v15/rockjam-piano-studio/index.html','life-curriculum/library/120-module-atlas.html','v15/body-school/clinic.html','skill-lab.html','learn.html?subject=books'];

function buildSearchIndex(){searchDocuments=[];const decoder=document.createElement('textarea');function plain(s){return String(s||'').replace(/<script\b[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/script>/gi,' ').replace(/<style\b[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/style>/gi,' ').replace(/<[^>]*>/g,' ').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim()}
 for(const [path,entry] of Object.entries(FILES)){if(!path.endsWith('.html'))continue;let s=entry.t||'',rawTitle=s.match(/<title[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/title>/i)?.[1]||path.split('/').pop();decoder.innerHTML=rawTitle;let title=decoder.value,body=plain(s).slice(0,18000);searchDocuments.push({path,title,body,norm:normal(title+' '+path+' '+body),subject:inferSubject(path)})}
 try{let topics=JSON.parse(fileText('learning/content.json'));for(const [sub,units] of Object.entries(topics))units.forEach((u,i)=>{let title=u.title,body=Object.entries(u).filter(([key,val])=>typeof val==='string'&&!['title'].includes(key)).map(x=>x[1]).join(' ').slice(0,2500);let path='learn.html?subject='+sub+'&unit='+i;searchDocuments.push({path,title,body,norm:normal(title+' '+body),subject:sub,type:'Guided lesson'})})}catch(e){console.warn('Guided lesson search unavailable',e)}
}
function resultsFor(raw,scope='all'){const terms=normal(raw).split(' ').filter(Boolean);if(terms.join('').length<2)return [];const exact=normal(raw);let ranked=[];for(const doc of searchDocuments){if(scope!=='all'&&doc.subject!==scope)continue;let title=normal(doc.title);let score=terms.reduce((s,t)=>s+(title.includes(t)?8:doc.norm.includes(t)?1:-20),0);if(!terms.every(t=>doc.norm.includes(t)))continue;score+=title.includes(exact)?20:0;let pos=doc.norm.indexOf(terms[0]);ranked.push({...doc,score,pos})}return ranked.sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score||a.title.localeCompare(b.title)).slice(0,14)}
function showSearchResults(query){const area=$('searchresults');if(query.trim().length<2){area.hidden=true;return}let scope=$('searchScope').value,results=resultsFor(query,scope);area.hidden=false;area.innerHTML='<div class="search-info">'+results.length+' '+(results.length===14?'top ':'')+'match'+(results.length===1?'':'es')+'</div>'+(results.length?results.map(r=>{let snippet=r.body.replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();let at=normal(snippet).indexOf(normal(query).split(' ')[0]);if(at<0)at=0;let start=Math.max(0,at-45);snippet=snippet.slice(start,start+135);return '<button data-result="'+h(r.path)+'"><strong>'+h(r.title.slice(0,80))+'</strong><span>'+h((r.type||r.subject)+' · '+snippet)+'…</span></button>'}).join(''):'<p class="small-muted">No matches. Try a shorter term, such as “subjunctive,” “profit,” or “castling.”</p>');area.querySelectorAll('[data-result]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{go(b.dataset.result);area.hidden=true})}
function findConcept(phrase,sub=subject){let needle=normal(phrase).replace(/[?!.,:;()]/g,' '),words=needle.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);if(!words.length)return null;let set=COACH_BANK[sub]||[],best=null,score=0;for(const c of set){let variants=[c.key,...c.aliases];let ss=variants.reduce((m,a)=>{let n=normal(a);if(n.length<2)return m;let exact=needle.includes(n)&&(/[^a-z]/.test(n)||n.length>3);let matched=exact?Math.min(15,5+n.length/5):0;return Math.max(m,matched)},0);if(ss>score){score=ss;best=c}}return best}
function setCoachHeading(txt){$('coachContext').textContent=txt||'Choose a concept, ask a question, or select text in the lesson.'}
function openCoach(text=''){if(!READY)return;$('coach').hidden=false;$('coachBtnClose').focus();const selected=text||coachSession.selected||'';setCoachHeading(selected?'Selected: “'+selected.slice(0,150)+'”':'Learning: '+SECTIONS[subject].name);if(selected){let result=findConcept(selected);if(result){coachSession.concept=result;coachSession.mode='simple';coachSession.step=0;renderCoach()}else{$('coachOutput').innerHTML='<p>I cannot explain that exact passage yet. Try asking about one specific word or idea, or open a related lesson.</p>';renderCoachMatches(selected)}}else if(coachSession.concept&&findConcept(coachSession.concept.key))renderCoach();else{coachSession.concept=null;showCoachSuggestions()}}
function closeCoach(){$('coach').hidden=true;$('helpBtn').focus()}
function showCoachSuggestions(){let concepts=COACH_BANK[subject]||[];$('coachOutput').innerHTML='<p>Pick the part that is confusing. I’ll start small and walk through it with you.</p><div class="chipline">'+concepts.map((c,i)=>'<button class="chip" data-concept="'+i+'">'+h(c.key)+'</button>').join('')+'</div><p class="small-muted">You can also select a phrase in the lesson and open Help.</p>';$('coachOutput').querySelectorAll('[data-concept]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{coachSession.concept=concepts[+b.dataset.concept];coachSession.mode='simple';coachSession.step=0;coachSession.incorrect=0;renderCoach()})}
function renderCoachMatches(text){let r=resultsFor(text).slice(0,4);let html='<p class="small-muted">I work best with ideas taught in these lessons. Try one of the related pages below.</p>';if(r.length)html+='<h4>Possibly relevant original lessons</h4>'+r.map(x=>'<button class="match-link" data-path="'+h(x.path)+'">'+h(x.title)+'</button>').join('');$('coachOutput').insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',html);$('coachOutput').querySelectorAll('[data-path]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{go(b.dataset.path);closeCoach()})}
function renderCoach(){let c=coachSession.concept;if(!c)return showCoachSuggestions();setCoachHeading('Working on: '+c.key);let mode=coachSession.mode,html='<div class="coachtopic"><span class="eyebrow">LET’S WORK THROUGH</span><h3>'+h(c.key)+'</h3></div><div class="coach-actions"><button class="coachchoice '+(mode==='simple'?'selected':'')+'" data-coach-mode="simple">Simpler</button><button class="coachchoice '+(mode==='steps'?'selected':'')+'" data-coach-mode="steps">One step</button><button class="coachchoice '+(mode==='example'?'selected':'')+'" data-coach-mode="example">Example</button><button class="coachchoice '+(mode==='check'?'selected':'')+'" data-coach-mode="check">Quick check</button></div>';
if(mode==='simple')html+='<div class="coachexplanation"><strong>Start here</strong><p>'+h(coachSession.incorrect>1?c.foundation:c.plain)+'</p></div><button class="button soft" id="getSteps">Break it into small steps →</button>';
if(mode==='steps'){let n=Math.min(coachSession.step,c.steps.length-1);html+='<div class="coachexplanation"><span class="eyebrow">STEP '+(n+1)+' OF '+c.steps.length+'</span><p>'+h(c.steps[n])+'</p></div><div class="coach-arrows"><button class="button" id="stepBack" '+(n===0?'disabled':'')+'>← Previous</button><button class="button primary" id="stepNext">'+(n===c.steps.length-1?'Try a quick check →':'Next small step →')+'</button></div>'}
if(mode==='example')html+='<div class="coachexplanation"><strong>In real life</strong><p>'+h(c.example)+'</p></div><button class="button primary" id="exampleToCheck">Let me try one →</button>';
if(mode==='check')html+='<div class="coachexplanation"><strong>Your turn</strong><p>'+h(c.question)+'</p></div><div class="coach-answers">'+c.choices.map((text,i)=>'<button data-coach-answer="'+i+'">'+h(text)+'</button>').join('')+'</div><div id="coachFeedback" role="status">'+h(coachSession.feedback)+'</div>';
html+='<div class="coach-lower"><button class="plain-link" id="coachAnother">Choose a different concept</button><button class="plain-link" id="coachSave">Save this to notebook</button></div>';$('coachOutput').innerHTML=html;$('coachOutput').querySelectorAll('[data-coach-mode]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{coachSession.mode=b.dataset.coachMode;coachSession.feedback='';if(coachSession.mode==='steps')coachSession.step=0;renderCoach()});if($('getSteps'))$('getSteps').onclick=()=>{coachSession.mode='steps';coachSession.step=0;renderCoach()};if($('stepBack'))$('stepBack').onclick=()=>{coachSession.step--;renderCoach()};if($('stepNext'))$('stepNext').onclick=()=>{if(coachSession.step<c.steps.length-1)coachSession.step++;else coachSession.mode='check';renderCoach()};if($('exampleToCheck'))$('exampleToCheck').onclick=()=>{coachSession.mode='check';renderCoach()};$('coachOutput').querySelectorAll('[data-coach-answer]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{let index=Number(b.dataset.coachAnswer);if(index===c.right){coachSession.feedback='Correct. '+c.feedback;safeStore.set('understood:'+subject+':'+c.key,true);coachSession.incorrect=0}else{coachSession.incorrect++;coachSession.feedback='Not quite—and that is useful information. '+c.foundation+' You can choose Simpler or One step, then retry.';safeStore.set('struggle:'+subject+':'+c.key,Math.min(99,(safeStore.get('struggle:'+subject+':'+c.key,0))+1))}renderCoach()});$('coachAnother').onclick=()=>{coachSession.concept=null;showCoachSuggestions()};$('coachSave').onclick=()=>{openNotebook(c.key+' — '+c.plain)}}
function submitCoachQuestion(){let q=$('coachQuestion').value.trim();if(!q)return;coachSession.question=q;let concept=findConcept(q);if(concept){coachSession.concept=concept;coachSession.mode='simple';coachSession.step=0;coachSession.incorrect=0;renderCoach()}else{coachSession.concept=null;$('coachOutput').innerHTML='<p>I cannot answer that confidently yet. Let me help you find the right lesson.</p>';renderCoachMatches(q)}}
function showSelectionPreview(text){coachSession.selected=String(text||'').slice(0,250);$('selectedSnippet').hidden=!text;$('selectedSnippet').textContent=text?'Selected from the lesson: “'+text.slice(0,100)+'”':''}
window.addEventListener('message',e=>{if(e.source!==$('frame')?.contentWindow||e.data?.type!=='study-selection')return;showSelectionPreview(e.data.text||'')});

function renderNotebook(){let notes=getNoteData(),saves=bookmarks();$('savedNotes').innerHTML=notes.length?notes.map((n,i)=>'<div class="saved-card"><strong>'+h(n.subject||'Notebook')+'</strong><time>'+h(new Date(n.when).toLocaleDateString())+'</time><p>'+h(n.text)+'</p><div><button data-note-open="'+i+'">Open lesson</button><button data-note-delete="'+i+'">Delete</button></div></div>').join(''):'<p class="small-muted">No notes yet. Your notes stay in this browser unless you export them.</p>';$('savedNotes').querySelectorAll('[data-note-open]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{let item=notes[+b.dataset.noteOpen];$('notebook').close();if(FILES[splitPath(item.path)])go(item.path)});$('savedNotes').querySelectorAll('[data-note-delete]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{notes.splice(+b.dataset.noteDelete,1);safeStore.set('notes',notes);renderNotebook()});$('savedPlaces').innerHTML=saves.length?saves.map((p,i)=>'<button class="match-link" data-bpath="'+h(p)+'">'+h(p.split('/').pop()+' · '+inferSubject(p))+'</button>').join(''):'<p class="small-muted">Use “Save place” beside any lesson to bookmark it.</p>';$('savedPlaces').querySelectorAll('[data-bpath]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{$('notebook').close();go(b.dataset.bpath)})}
function saveNotebookNote(){let value=$('noteText').value.trim();if(!value){$('noteStatus').textContent='Write a short note first.';return}let notes=getNoteData();notes.unshift({text:value,path:activePath,subject:SECTIONS[subject]?.name||'General',when:new Date().toISOString()});let persisted=safeStore.set('notes',notes.slice(0,500));$('noteText').value='';$('noteStatus').textContent=persisted?'Saved on this device.':'Saved for this session only; export notes to keep them.';renderNotebook()}
function exportNotebook(){const blob=new Blob([JSON.stringify({version:1,notes:getNoteData(),bookmarks:bookmarks(),recent:safeStore.get('recent',[])},null,2)],{type:'application/json'}),a=document.createElement('a');let url=URL.createObjectURL(blob);a.href=url;a.download='study-table-notebook.json';a.click();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),30000)}
async function importNotebook(file){if(!file)return;try{let raw=await file.text();if(raw.length>2_000_000)throw Error('File is too large');let obj=JSON.parse(raw);if(!Array.isArray(obj.notes)||!Array.isArray(obj.bookmarks))throw Error('Not a Study Table notebook');let notes=obj.notes.filter(x=>typeof x.text==='string'&&x.text.length<10000&&typeof x.path==='string'&&typeof x.subject==='string').slice(0,500);let paths=obj.bookmarks.filter(x=>typeof x==='string'&&FILES[splitPath(x)]).slice(0,150);safeStore.set('notes',notes);safeStore.set('bookmarks',paths);renderNotebook();setControls();$('noteStatus').textContent='Imported '+notes.length+' notes and '+paths.length+' bookmarks.'}catch(e){$('noteStatus').textContent='Import failed: '+e.message}}

/* V20: Complete original resources, fix redirects and offline iframe state. */
// Reuse object URLs instead of allocating a new blob on every revisit.
const __uncachedAssetURL=assetURL,assetURLCache=new Map();
assetURL=function(path){if(assetURLCache.has(path))return assetURLCache.get(path);const url=__uncachedAssetURL(path);if(url)assetURLCache.set(path,url);return url};
const __goV19Full=go;
go=function(path,opts={}){
 const p=splitPath(path), entry=FILES[p];
 if(p==='v45-home.html' && !String(path).includes('#') && !new URLSearchParams(String(path).split('?')[1]||'').has('library'))return __goV19Full('studio/index.html',opts);
 if(entry?.t && p.endsWith('.html')){
  const redirect=entry.t.match(/<meta\b[^>]*http-equiv=["']refresh["'][^>]*content=["'][^"']*?url=([^"']+)["']/i);
  if(redirect){const target=normalizePath(redirect[1],p);if(target){__goV19Full(target,opts);return}}
 }
 return __goV19Full(path,opts);
};
window.addEventListener('message',event=>{
 if(event.source!==$('frame')?.contentWindow)return;
 const d=event.data;
 if(d?.type!=='study-course-storage'||typeof d.page!=='string'||d.page!==splitPath(activePath))return;
 const store=safeStore.get('course-store:'+d.page,{});
 if(d.op==='clear'){safeStore.set('course-store:'+d.page,{});return}
 if(typeof d.key!=='string'||d.key.length>250)return;
 if(d.op==='remove'){delete store[d.key]}
 else if(d.op==='set'&&typeof d.value==='string'&&d.value.length<500000){store[d.key]=d.value}
 else return;
 safeStore.set('course-store:'+d.page,store);
});
function showArchive(){
 if(!READY)return;
 $('archiveCount').textContent=Object.keys(FILES).filter(p=>p.endsWith('.html')).length+' original HTML pages, '+Object.keys(FILES).filter(p=>p.endsWith('.pdf')).length+' PDFs, '+Object.keys(FILES).length+' original files total — including all seven subjects.';
 $('archiveDialog').showModal();$('archiveFilter').value='';renderArchive('');$('archiveFilter').focus();
}
function renderArchive(q){
 let terms=normal(q).split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
 let paths=Object.keys(FILES).filter(p=>p.endsWith('.html')||p.endsWith('.pdf')||p.endsWith('.epub')||p.endsWith('.md'));
 if(terms.length)paths=paths.filter(p=>terms.every(t=>normal(p).includes(t)));
 let visible=paths.slice(0,120);
 $('archiveResults').innerHTML=visible.length?visible.map(p=>'<button type="button" data-archive-path="'+h(p)+'"><strong>'+h(p.split('/').pop())+'</strong><small>'+h(p)+'</small></button>').join(''):'<p>No matching original files. Try a broader search.</p>';
 if(paths.length>visible.length)$('archiveResults').insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend','<p class="small-muted">Showing the first '+visible.length+' of '+paths.length+' matching files. Narrow your search to see more.</p>');
 $('archiveResults').querySelectorAll('[data-archive-path]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{let p=b.dataset.archivePath;$('archiveDialog').close();if(p.endsWith('.md')){const asset=assetURL(p);window.open(asset,'_blank','noopener')}else go(p)});
}
$('archiveBtn').onclick=showArchive;
$('archiveClose').onclick=()=>$('archiveDialog').close();
$('archiveFilter').oninput=e=>renderArchive(e.target.value);
$('archiveHistory').onclick=()=>{$('archiveDialog').close();go('v15/before-the-ending-reader/full-book.pdf')};

let v21CourseData=null, v21TrailActive=false, v21TrailSubject='spanish', v21TrailIndex=0, v21Attempt=false, v21Messages=[], v21HelpContext=null, v21ChatFocus=null;
function v21Data(){if(v21CourseData)return v21CourseData;try{v21CourseData=JSON.parse(FILES['learning/content.json'].t)}catch(e){console.warn('Guide content was not available',e);v21CourseData={life:[],medicine:[],business:[],books:[]}}return v21CourseData}
function v21Items(s){if(v21Data()[s])return v21Data()[s].map((x,i)=>({kind:'course',title:x.title,content:x,index:i}));return (COACH_BANK[s]||[]).map((x,i)=>({kind:'foundation',title:x.key,content:x,index:i}))}
function v21CurrentItem(){return v21TrailActive?v21Items(v21TrailSubject)[v21TrailIndex]:null}
function v21Title(x){return x?.title||'Your next lesson'}
function v21Plain(x){const z=x?.content||{};return z.plain||z.core||z.explain||z.overview||z.hook||''}
function v21Example(x){const z=x?.content||{};return z.example||z.case||z.scene||z.anchor||''}
function v21Question(x){const z=x?.content||{};return z.question||('What do you notice about '+x?.title+'?')}
function v21Answer(x){const z=x?.content||{};return z.answer||z.correct||z.feedback||''}
function v21Mistake(x){const z=x?.content||{};return z.trap||z.skepticism||z.guardrail||''}
function v21FirstStep(s,entry){const z=entry.content;if(z.foundation)return z.foundation;
 if(s==='books')return z.hook||'Begin with the author’s central claim, not the chapter titles.';
 return v21Plain(entry);
}
function v21ReasoningSteps(s,entry){const z=entry.content;if(Array.isArray(z.steps)&&z.steps.length)return z.steps.map((t,i)=>(i+1)+'. '+t).join('\n');
 const guide={books:['State the central argument in one sentence.','Find the strongest example or piece of evidence.','Ask what a thoughtful critic would question.'],life:['Ask what is being explained and which causes matter.','Use the example to test your intuition.','Notice the tempting oversimplification, then refine it.'],medicine:['Identify what the healthy system normally regulates.','Change one variable and predict the effect.','Trace how other organs respond and check the example.'],business:['Identify the customer, their problem, and the value delivered.','Follow the money: revenue, cost, and what remains.','Choose one practical experiment to test the idea.']};
 return (guide[s]||['State the main idea.','Work through one example.','Explain it back in your own words.']).map((t,i)=>(i+1)+'. '+t).join('\n')+'\n\n'+v21Plain(entry);
}
function v21FindConcept(phrase,sub){
 const normalized=normal(phrase).replace(/[^a-z0-9\s']/g,' ').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();if(!normalized)return null;
 const padded=' '+normalized+' ';let best=null,bestScore=0;
 for(const c of (COACH_BANK[sub]||[]))for(const alias of [c.key,...c.aliases]){
    let word=normal(alias).replace(/[^a-z0-9\s']/g,' ').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();
    if(word.length<3)continue;
    if(padded.includes(' '+word+' ')){let score=word.length+(word.includes(' ')?12:0);if(score>bestScore){best=c;bestScore=score}}
 }
 return best;
}
function v21Progress(s){let d=safeStore.get('v21:finished:'+s,[]);return Array.isArray(d)?d:[]}
function v21Route(s,i=0){if(!READY)return;if(typeof v35Close==='function'&&document.getElementById('v35Portal')&&!document.getElementById('v35Portal').hidden)v35Close();v21HelpContext=null;v21TrailActive=true;document.body.classList.add('v21-guided');if($('v21MobileSubject'))$('v21MobileSubject').value=s;v21TrailSubject=s;subject=s;let items=v21Items(s);v21TrailIndex=Math.max(0,Math.min(items.length-1,Number(i)||0));safeStore.set('v21:lastGuided',{subject:s,index:v21TrailIndex});safeStore.set('v21:lastMode','guided');$('resumeBtn').disabled=false;drawMenu();v21RenderTrail();}
function v21Markup(text){return h(text||'').replace(/\n/g,'<br>')}
function v21RenderTrail(){const s=v21TrailSubject,items=v21Items(s),meta=V21_NARRATIVES[s],entry=items[v21TrailIndex];if(!entry)return;v21Attempt=false;const c=entry.content;

function v21ShowCoach(prompt=''){if(!READY)return;
 const focus=v21HelpContext||null;
 if(focus){subject=focus.subject;let match=v21FindConcept(prompt,subject);coachSession.concept=match||null}
 openCoach(focus?'':prompt);
 if(focus){$('coachQuestion').placeholder='Ask about '+focus.item.title+'…';$('coachContext').textContent='Studying: '+focus.item.title;$('selectedSnippet').hidden=false;$('selectedSnippet').textContent='Current lesson: '+focus.item.title;}
 if(!v21Messages.length)v21WriteChat('assistant','Tell me where you lost the thread. We can start small, use an example, or go one step at a time.');
}
function v21WriteChat(who,message){if(!message)return;v21Messages.push({who,text:String(message).slice(0,2800)});v21Messages=v21Messages.slice(-14);let log=$('v21ChatLog');log.innerHTML=v21Messages.map(x=>'<div class="chat-bubble '+x.who+'"><span>'+(x.who==='assistant'?'STUDY COACH':'YOU')+'</span>'+h(x.text)+'</div>').join('');log.scrollTop=log.scrollHeight;}
function v21ChatReply(raw){let input=String(raw||'').trim().slice(0,350);if(!input)return;v21WriteChat('user',input);$('coachQuestion').value='';const s=v21HelpContext?.subject||subject;let explicitConcept=v21FindConcept(input,s);let followup=/^(explain|simpler|again|start from zero|from zero|another example|give me an example|show me an example|one step|break it into steps|quiz me|test me|why|why does it matter|i don't get it|i am confused)[?!. ]*$/i.test(input);let matched=explicitConcept||(followup&&v21ChatFocus?.subject===s?v21ChatFocus.concept:null);let guide=v21HelpContext?.item||null;
 const ask=normal(input);const intent=/\b(quiz|test me|check my understanding|practice question)\b/.test(ask)?'quiz':/example|real.life|use it|show me/.test(ask)?'example':/step|slow|break|walk|one at a time/.test(ask)?'steps':/simple|beginner|zero|basics|don't understand|confus/.test(ask)?'simple':/why|matter|point|purpose/.test(ask)?'why':'explain';
 // A new recognized concept wins over previous context; otherwise explain the lesson that is visibly open.
 if(matched && (!guide||explicitConcept)){v21ChatFocus={subject:s,concept:matched};coachSession.concept=matched;coachSession.mode=({quiz:'check',example:'example',steps:'steps',simple:'simple',why:'simple',explain:'simple'})[intent];coachSession.step=0;renderCoach();
 const answer={quiz:'I have a check-for-understanding question below. Choose an answer and I will explain the reasoning.',example:matched.example||matched.plain,steps:'Start with this: '+matched.steps[0]+'\nUse “One step” below to continue.',simple:matched.foundation||matched.plain,why:matched.plain+'\nExample: '+matched.example,explain:matched.plain}[intent];v21WriteChat('assistant',answer);return}
 if(guide){v21ChatFocus=null;let c=guide.content,reply={quiz:'Try explaining the idea in one sentence before checking the worked answer: '+v21Question(guide)+'\nUse the quiz or teach-back section in the guided lesson.',example:v21Example(guide)||'Open the full lesson for an example of how this works.',steps:v21ReasoningSteps(s,guide),simple:v21FirstStep(s,guide),why:c.why||V21_NARRATIVES[s].why+'\n'+v21Plain(guide),explain:v21Plain(guide)}[intent];v21WriteChat('assistant',reply);$('coachOutput').innerHTML='<div class="guide-coachhint"><strong>From your current guided lesson:</strong> '+h(guide.title)+'<br><button class="match-link" id="v21CoachBack" type="button">Return to this lesson</button></div>';$('v21CoachBack').onclick=closeCoach;return}
 // Avoid inventing an answer for arbitrary questions. Offer grounded search and next-step actions.
 const hits=resultsFor(input,s).slice(0,3);let suggestion=hits.length?'I cannot explain that confidently, but these lessons may help.':'I am not sure about that question yet. Try naming the exact idea, or choose a topic below.';v21WriteChat('assistant',suggestion);
 $('coachOutput').innerHTML='<p class="small-muted">'+h(suggestion)+'</p>'+hits.map((r,i)=>'<button class="match-link" data-v21match="'+i+'">'+h(r.title)+'</button>').join('')+'<p class="small-muted">I’ll point you toward a useful lesson when I cannot answer a question reliably.</p>';
 $('coachOutput').querySelectorAll('[data-v21match]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{go(hits[+b.dataset.v21match].path);closeCoach()})
}
function v21SetSubjectGuide(){v21Route(subject,safeStore.get('v21:lastGuided',{})?.subject===subject?safeStore.get('v21:lastGuided',{}).index:0)}
function v21Init(){
 const pathBtn=$('v21PathBtn');pathBtn.onclick=v21SetSubjectGuide;
 $('v21MobileSubject').value=subject;$('v21MobileSubject').onchange=e=>{let s=e.target.value;if(v21TrailActive)v21Route(s);else chooseSubject(s)};
 $('v21SidebarBtn').onclick=v21SetSubjectGuide;
 $('v21CoachOpen').onclick=()=>{v21HelpContext=v21TrailActive?{subject:v21TrailSubject,item:v21CurrentItem()}:null;v21ShowCoach()};
 // Keep a visible, conversational transcript without hiding existing step-by-step coach controls.
 $('v21CoachClear').onclick=()=>{v21Messages=[];$('v21ChatLog').innerHTML='';v21WriteChat('assistant','New question. Tell me what you are trying to understand.')};
 $('v21ChatPrompts').querySelectorAll('[data-prompt]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>v21ChatReply(b.dataset.prompt));
 $('askCoach').onclick=()=>v21ChatReply($('coachQuestion').value);
 $('coachQuestion').onkeydown=e=>{if(e.key==='Enter'){e.preventDefault();v21ChatReply(e.target.value)}};
 $('coachFromZero').onclick=()=>{if(v21HelpContext){v21ChatReply('Explain this from zero')}else{coachSession.concept=(COACH_BANK[subject]||[])[0];coachSession.mode='simple';renderCoach()}};
 const oldOpen=$('helpBtn').onclick;
 $('helpBtn').onclick=()=>{if(v21TrailActive){v21HelpContext={subject:v21TrailSubject,item:v21CurrentItem()};v21ShowCoach(v21Question(v21CurrentItem()))}else{v21HelpContext=null;v21ShowCoach()}};
 const oldResume=$('resumeBtn').onclick;
 $('resumeBtn').onclick=()=>{let recent=safeStore.get('v21:lastGuided');if(recent&&V21_NARRATIVES[recent.subject]&&safeStore.get('v21:lastMode')==='guided'){v21Route(recent.subject,recent.index);return}oldResume()};
 let recent=safeStore.get('v21:lastGuided');if(recent?.subject&&V21_NARRATIVES[recent.subject])$('v21PathBtn').textContent='Start a lesson';
 // The original archive remains read-only. Only the new learning shell stores user progress.
 $('v21Intro').textContent='First principles, examples, a quick check, then the complete original course. Nothing shortened or removed.';
}

/* Back up new guided progress along with notebook notes. */
window.studyTableGuidedLength=s=>Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(V21_NARRATIVES,s)?v21Items(s).length:-1;function v21Backup(){
 const progress={};const teachbacks={};
 for(const s of Object.keys(V21_NARRATIVES)){
  progress[s]=v21Progress(s);
  for(let i=0;i<v21Items(s).length;i++){
    const t=safeStore.get('v21:teachback:'+s+':'+i,'');if(t)teachbacks[s+':'+i]=String(t).slice(0,10000);
  }
 }
 return {version:2,notes:getNoteData(),bookmarks:bookmarks(),recent:safeStore.get('recent',[]),guided:{last:safeStore.get('v21:lastGuided'),lastMode:safeStore.get('v21:lastMode'),progress,teachbacks}};
}
exportNotebook=function(){
 const content=JSON.stringify(v21Backup(),null,2),blob=new Blob([content],{type:'application/json'}),a=document.createElement('a');
 let url=URL.createObjectURL(blob);a.href=url;a.download='study-table-complete-backup.json';a.click();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),30000);
};
const __v21PreviousImport=importNotebook;
importNotebook=async function(file){
 if(!file)return;let incoming;
 try{if(file.size>2_000_000)throw Error('Backup is too large');incoming=JSON.parse(await file.text())}catch(e){$('noteStatus').textContent='Import failed: '+e.message;return}
 await __v21PreviousImport(file);
 if(!incoming.guided||incoming.version!==2)return;
 let saved=0;const d=incoming.guided;
 if(d.progress&&typeof d.progress==='object')for(const [s,values] of Object.entries(d.progress)){
   if(!V21_NARRATIVES[s]||!Array.isArray(values))continue;
   const clean=[...new Set(values.filter(i=>Number.isInteger(i)&&i>=0&&i<v21Items(s).length))];
   safeStore.set('v21:finished:'+s,clean);saved+=clean.length;
 }
 if(d.teachbacks&&typeof d.teachbacks==='object')for(const [id,value] of Object.entries(d.teachbacks)){
  const m=id.match(/^(spanish|chess|piano|life|medicine|business|books):(\d+)$/);
  if(!m||Number(m[2])>=v21Items(m[1]).length||typeof value!=='string'||value.length>10000)continue;
  safeStore.set('v21:teachback:'+id,value);
 }
 if(d.last&&V21_NARRATIVES[d.last.subject]&&Number.isInteger(d.last.index)&&d.last.index>=0&&d.last.index<v21Items(d.last.subject).length)safeStore.set('v21:lastGuided',d.last);
 if(['guided','original'].includes(d.lastMode))safeStore.set('v21:lastMode',d.lastMode);
 $('noteStatus').textContent+=' Guided progress restored for '+saved+' explored topics.';
};

const __v21PreviousLoad=loadData;
loadData=async function(){await __v21PreviousLoad();v21Init()};

/* Study Table: a calmer way to practise. The complete course archive is kept unchanged. */
const V22_SUBJECTS=['spanish','chess','piano','life','medicine','business','books'];
const V22_STORAGE='v22:remember:v1';
let v22Session=null;
function v22Records(){let x=safeStore.get(V22_STORAGE,{});return x&&typeof x==='object'&&!Array.isArray(x)?x:{}}
function v22ItemId(s,i){return s+':'+i}
function v22DateAfter(days){let d=new Date();d.setHours(12,0,0,0);d.setDate(d.getDate()+days);return d.getTime()}
function v22Remember(s,i,level){
 const records=v22Records(),id=v22ItemId(s,i),old=records[id]||{};
 const last=Number(old.gap)||0;
 const gap=level==='again'?1:level==='almost'?Math.max(1,Math.min(last,3)):last<3?3:last<7?7:last<14?14:last<30?30:60;
 records[id]={gap,due:v22DateAfter(gap),seen:(Number(old.seen)||0)+1,last:Date.now(),level};
 safeStore.set(V22_STORAGE,records);v22UpdateButtons();return gap;
}
function v22Due(){let now=Date.now(),records=v22Records();return Object.keys(records).filter(id=>{let [s,n]=id.split(':');return V22_SUBJECTS.includes(s)&&Number.isInteger(Number(n))&&Number(n)>=0&&Number(n)<v21Items(s).length&&Number(records[id]?.due)<=now})}
function v22Available(sub='all'){
 let subjects=sub==='all'?V22_SUBJECTS:[sub];return subjects.flatMap(s=>v21Items(s).map((entry,i)=>({subject:s,index:i,id:v22ItemId(s,i),entry})));
}
function v22Select(mode,sub='all',count=3){
 const records=v22Records(),pool=v22Available(sub),now=Date.now();
 const due=pool.filter(x=>records[x.id]&&Number(records[x.id].due)<=now);
 if(mode==='review'&&!due.length)return [];
 let bag=mode==='review'?due:mode==='easy'?pool.filter(x=>x.index<4||records[x.id]):pool.filter(x=>x.index<(mode==='challenge'?18:10)||records[x.id]);
 const previous=safeStore.get('v22:last-picks',[]);
 const position=x=>{
  let rec=records[x.id];if(mode==='review')return Number(rec?.due)||0;
  let already=previous.includes(x.id)?40:0;
  let novelty=rec?15+Math.min(Number(rec.seen)||0,15):0;
  if(rec?.due<=now)novelty-=12;
  let intro=mode==='easy'?Math.min(x.index,15)*2:mode==='challenge'?x.index<3?10:0:Math.min(x.index,12);
  return intro+novelty+already+Math.random()*7;
 };
 bag=[...bag].map(x=>({...x,rank:position(x)})).sort((a,b)=>a.rank-b.rank);
 const selection=[];const subjectsSeen=new Set();
 for(const x of bag){if(selection.length>=count)break;if(sub==='all'&&subjectsSeen.has(x.subject)&&subjectsSeen.size<Math.min(count,7))continue;selection.push(x);subjectsSeen.add(x.subject)}
 for(const x of bag){if(selection.length>=count)break;if(!selection.some(y=>x.id===y.id))selection.push(x)}
 return selection;
}
function v22Begin(mode='easy',sub='all'){
 if(!READY)return;
 if(sub!=='all'&&!V22_SUBJECTS.includes(sub))sub='all';
 const tasks=v22Select(mode,sub,3);
 if(mode==='review'&&!tasks.length){v22ShowEmptyReview();return}
 if(!tasks.length)return;
 safeStore.set('v22:last-picks',tasks.map(x=>x.id));
 v22Session={mode,sub,tasks,index:0,chosen:null,revealed:false,missed:false,ownAnswer:'',started:Date.now()};
 v22RenderSession();
}
function v22SessionHeader(){return '<div class="v22-heading"><span class="eyebrow">A LITTLE PRACTICE</span><button class="v22-textbtn" id="v22Exit" type="button">Back to the library</button></div>'}
function v22RenderSession(){
 if(!READY||!v22Session)return;
 v21TrailActive=false;v21HelpContext=null;document.body.classList.remove('v21-guided');
 const session=v22Session,step=session.index;
 if(step>=session.tasks.length){v22FinishSession();return}
 const {subject:s,index:i,entry}=session.tasks[step],c=entry.content,choices=Array.isArray(c.choices)&&c.choices.length>1&&Number.isInteger(c.right);
 const desc=V21_NARRATIVES[s];subject=s;drawMenu();
 $('pageTitle').textContent='Three questions';$('status').textContent='Your pace. Your choice. No timer.';
 const prompt=v21Question(entry);
 const answer=choices?(String(c.choices[c.right])+'. '+(c.feedback||c.plain||'')):(s==='books'?(c.hook||c.overview||v21Plain(entry)):(v21Answer(entry)||v21Plain(entry)));
 const introduction=({spanish:'Say it aloud if you feel like it.',chess:'Picture the board before choosing.',piano:'Tap the rhythm with your fingers.',life:'Start with your first instinct.',medicine:'Think about what normally happens in the body.',business:'Imagine you have to make the decision tomorrow.',books:'Try to state the author’s argument in one sentence.'})[s];
 $('screen').innerHTML=`<div class="v22-session">${v22SessionHeader()}<div class="v22-session-top"><span>${h(desc.label)}</span><span>${step+1} of ${session.tasks.length}</span></div><div class="v22-session-track" aria-hidden="true"><span style="width:${step/session.tasks.length*100}%"></span></div><article class="v22-question"><p class="v22-kicker">${h(introduction)}</p><h1>${h(entry.title)}</h1><p class="v22-questionline">${h(prompt)}</p>${s==='medicine'?'<p class="v22-med-note">For learning only, not personal medical advice.</p>':''}${choices?'<div class="v22-choices">'+c.choices.map((text,j)=>`<button type="button" data-v22-choice="${j}">${h(text)}</button>`).join('')+'</div>':`<label for="v22OwnAnswer" class="v22-answer-label">What's your guess?</label><textarea id="v22OwnAnswer" rows="3" placeholder="A few words are enough. You can also think it through silently."></textarea>`}<div class="v22-helpbuttons"><button type="button" id="v22Hint">A small hint</button><button type="button" id="v22Reveal" class="v22-primary">${choices?'Show me why':'Show the explanation'}</button><button type="button" id="v22Ask">I'm stuck</button></div><div id="v22HintText" class="v22-hint" hidden role="status"></div><div id="v22Solution" class="v22-solution" hidden><p class="eyebrow">THE IDEA</p><p class="v22-solutiontext">${h(answer)}</p>${s==='spanish'&&choices?'<button id="v22Hear" type="button" class="v22-outline">Hear the Spanish</button>':''}${v21Example(entry)?'<p><strong>For example:</strong> '+h(v21Example(entry))+'</p>':''}${v21Mistake(entry)?'<p class="v22-mistake"><strong>Worth remembering:</strong> '+h(v21Mistake(entry))+'</p>':''}<div id="v22Rating"><p class="v22-rating-question">How did that feel?</p><div class="v22-ratings"><button data-v22-rate="again" type="button">I'm still fuzzy</button><button data-v22-rate="almost" type="button">Getting there</button><button data-v22-rate="clear" type="button">That clicked</button></div><p class="v22-feedback" id="v22Memory" role="status"></p></div><div class="v22-nextline"><button class="v22-primary" id="v22Next" type="button">${step===session.tasks.length-1?'Finish for now':'Next question →'}</button><button class="v22-textbtn" id="v22FullCourse" type="button">Open the full course</button></div></div></article><p class="v22-footer">There is no need to finish. One thing understood is a good session.</p></div>`;
 $('v22Exit').onclick=()=>{v22Session=null;showHome()};
 $('v22Hint').onclick=()=>{let tip=c.foundation||(Array.isArray(c.steps)?c.steps[0]:'')||v21FirstStep(s,entry);$('v22HintText').hidden=false;$('v22HintText').textContent=tip};
 $('v22Reveal').onclick=()=>v22Reveal();
 $('v22Ask').onclick=()=>{if(v21HelpContext?.item?.title!==entry.title){v21Messages=[];v21ChatFocus=null;}v21HelpContext={subject:s,item:entry};v21ShowCoach(prompt);v21ChatReply('Start from zero')};
 if(choices)$('screen').querySelectorAll('[data-v22-choice]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{
   let j=Number(b.dataset.v22Choice),right=j===c.right;
   if(!right)session.missed=true;
   session.chosen=j;
   $('screen').querySelectorAll('[data-v22-choice]').forEach(q=>{q.classList.toggle('v22-chosen',q===b);q.setAttribute('aria-pressed',q===b?'true':'false')});
   v22Reveal();
   $('v22HintText').hidden=false;
   $('v22HintText').textContent=right?'Yes — '+(c.feedback||'See why this works below.'):'Not quite. '+(c.foundation||'Look at the explanation and try to reason it through.');
   $('v22Memory').textContent=right?'You can choose when to revisit this.':'It helps to revisit this tomorrow.';
 });
 if(!choices)$('v22OwnAnswer').oninput=e=>{session.ownAnswer=e.target.value};
}
function v22Reveal(){if(!v22Session)return;v22Session.revealed=true;$('v22Solution').hidden=false;$('v22Solution').scrollIntoView({behavior:window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches?'auto':'smooth',block:'nearest'});
 $('screen').querySelectorAll('[data-v22-rate]').forEach(btn=>btn.onclick=()=>{
  const {subject:s,index:i}=v22Session.tasks[v22Session.index];
  const level=v22Session.missed&&btn.dataset.v22Rate==='clear'?'almost':btn.dataset.v22Rate;
  const gap=v22Remember(s,i,level);
  $('screen').querySelectorAll('[data-v22-rate]').forEach(b=>{b.classList.toggle('v22-rated',b===btn);b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',b===btn?'true':'false')});
  $('v22Memory').textContent=level==='again'?'We’ll bring it back tomorrow.':`We'll bring this back in ${gap} day${gap===1?'':'s'}.`;
 });
 if($('v22Hear'))$('v22Hear').onclick=()=>{if(!('speechSynthesis' in window)){$('v22Memory').textContent='Audio playback is not available here.';return;}try{window.speechSynthesis.cancel();let utterance=new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(v22Session.tasks[v22Session.index].entry.content.choices[v22Session.tasks[v22Session.index].entry.content.right]);utterance.lang='es-MX';utterance.rate=.83;window.speechSynthesis.speak(utterance)}catch{$('v22Memory').textContent='Audio playback is not available here.'}};
 $('v22Next').onclick=()=>{v22Session.index++;v22Session.missed=false;v22Session.revealed=false;v22RenderSession()};
 $('v22FullCourse').onclick=()=>{let s=v22Session.tasks[v22Session.index].subject;v22Session=null;go(V21_NARRATIVES[s].original)};
}
function v22FinishSession(){
 const session=v22Session;const titles=session.tasks.map(x=>'<li><strong>'+h(V21_NARRATIVES[x.subject].label)+':</strong> '+h(x.entry.title)+'</li>').join('');
 $('pageTitle').textContent='A few good minutes';$('status').textContent='Come back whenever you feel like it.';
 $('screen').innerHTML='<div class="v22-finish"><span class="eyebrow">COME BACK WHEN YOU LIKE</span><h1>A few ideas worth keeping.</h1><p>You tried a few questions and checked your thinking. That is how an idea starts to stick.</p><ul>'+titles+'</ul><div class="v22-actions"><button class="v22-primary" id="v22More">Another three?</button><button class="v22-outline" id="v22ToCourse">Explore the full courses</button><button class="v22-outline" id="v22Review">See what is worth revisiting</button></div></div>';
 $('v22More').onclick=()=>v22Begin(session.mode,session.sub);
 $('v22ToCourse').onclick=()=>{v22Session=null;showHome()};
 $('v22Review').onclick=()=>v22Begin('review',session.sub);
 v22Session=null;
}
function v22ShowEmptyReview(){v22Session=null;$('pageTitle').textContent='A fresh start';$('screen').innerHTML='<div class="v22-finish"><span class="eyebrow">NOTHING WAITING</span><h1>Nothing needs revisiting right now.</h1><p>Once you practise a few ideas, this space will bring them back when they might be slipping away. No streaks to maintain.</p><div class="v22-actions"><button class="v22-primary" id="v22New">Try three new ideas</button><button class="v22-outline" id="v22Home">Back to my courses</button></div></div>';$('v22New').onclick=()=>v22Begin('easy');$('v22Home').onclick=showHome}
function v22UpdateButtons(){let n=v22Due().length;for(let id of ['v22ReviewBtn','v22HomeReview']){let b=$(id);if(b)b.textContent=n?`Revisit ${n} idea${n===1?'':'s'}`:'Revisit an idea'};
}
function v22InsertHome(){
 const home=$('screen').querySelector('.v21-home');if(!home)return;
 $('pageTitle').textContent='Welcome to Study Table';
 const intro=home.querySelector('.home-intro');
 if(intro){intro.innerHTML='<span class="eyebrow">A PLACE FOR YOUR CURIOSITY</span><h1>Follow whatever interests you.</h1><p>Try a question. Get curious. Make a little progress. Spanish, music, chess, science, business and great books are all here when you want them.</p>'}
 const how=home.querySelector('.how');if(how){how.innerHTML='<div><strong>Pick what sounds fun</strong>No timetable to follow.</div><div><strong>Have a go</strong>A guess is a useful beginning.</div><div><strong>Find the missing piece</strong>Ask for a clue or see the reasoning.</div><div><strong>Keep exploring</strong>Open the full lesson whenever you want.</div>'}
 home.querySelectorAll('.home-ctas [data-start]').forEach(b=>b.textContent='Start with a lesson');
 home.querySelectorAll('.home-ctas [data-full]').forEach(b=>b.textContent='Explore the full course');
 const foot=home.querySelector('.footnote');if(foot)foot.textContent='All seven complete courses are included. Notes stay in your browser unless you save a backup. The help panel works from the lessons in this app; for questions it can’t answer, it will point you to a relevant lesson.';
 const card=document.createElement('section');card.className='v22-feature';card.innerHTML='<div><span class="eyebrow">IN THE MOOD TO LEARN?</span><h2>Three questions. Something new to understand.</h2><p>No timer. No streaks.
